C0670.title: Abuse of 'Refund-Only' and 'No-Reason Returns' Rules: Integrity Must Be Upheld by the Rule of Law
C0670.summary: In July 2024, the Zhongshan Court in Guangxi mediated a dispute over a 'refund-only' claim. A buyer exploited the platform's refund-only policy to take advantage of a merchant; after mediation, the buyer returned the payment and covered the seller's legal costs. The report notes that some consumers misuse the 'seven-day no-reason return' rule by returning used products.

references.title: 'Refund only' and 'no-questions-asked returns' abused, integrity must be protected by rule of law
